svg.title: Manish Singh: a dig through the full stack
svg.desc: Manish Singh, full stack engineer. Experience: Associate Software Engineer at Appbrew Technologies, Feb 2026 – now; SDE Intern at Braktt Technologies, May 2023 – Jan 2024; Frontend Intern at Braktt Technologies, Oct 2022 – Apr 2023. Projects: Geeli Maati, Pottery studio booking and shop; Repset, Multi-tenant gym SaaS; Rachnakaar, Writing in Indian languages. Stack: Interface: React, Next.js, React Native, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, React Query, Redux Toolkit, Zustand. Server: Node.js, Next.js Server Actions and Route Handlers, REST APIs, tRPC, Zod. Data: PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Prisma ORM, schema design, transactions, row locking. Plumbing: Better Auth, Clerk, JWT, OAuth, RBAC, Razorpay, UPI, Cloudinary, Resend, Vitest. Foundation: B.Tech in Computer Science, UIT RGPV, 2021 to 2025.

g.text: Full stack engineer. I build from the pixel down to the row lock.
A request is about to dig through everything I've built. Follow it down.
Cross-platform apps on React Native's Fabric architecture
Data dashboards on REST APIs, 25% faster Largest Contentful Paint
Reusable React component library and JWT sign-in flows
Each one pulled up as a drill core, interface on top, data at the bottom.
React, Next.js, React Native, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, React Query, Redux Toolkit, Zustand
Node.js, Next.js Server Actions and Route Handlers, REST APIs, tRPC, Zod
PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Prisma ORM, schema design, transactions, row locking
Better Auth, Clerk, JWT, OAuth, RBAC, Razorpay, UPI, Cloudinary, Resend, Vitest
B.Tech in Computer Science, UIT RGPV, Bhopal
React workshops for 35+ students at CodeCult; 20+ sessions as Web Master, Asper Club
200 OK. Thanks for digging this far.
